title: Energy-Flow Cosmology (EFC v2.1): Modular Synthesis across Structure, Dynamics, and Cognition
abstract: Formalizes Energy-Flow Cosmology v2.1 as a modular framework linking structural (halos in a Grid–Higgs medium), dynamical (energy flow–entropy–time relations), and cognitive (informational coupling) domains. Replaces dark components with a measurable energy-flow field Ef governed by entropic gradients, proposes a variable light velocity c(S) tied to energy density, and interprets the CMB as a steady-state thermodynamic equilibrium.
